'''Yennir of the Green''' was a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] in the [[Republic Army]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. In [[3640 BBY]], Yennir was assigned to [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Shanra Immel]]'s [[Shanra Immel's squad|squad]] and served with [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Jace Malcom]] during a [[Battle of Kalandis Seven|battle]] on [[Kalandis Seven]]. In the battle, Yennir and the [[Squad/Legends|squad]] successfully planted [[targeting beacon]]s to enable a Republic [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Fighter wing|wing]] to [[Bomb/Legends|bomb]] the [[Kalandis Seven's spaceport|local spaceport]].

==Biography==
[[File:Malcom_and_Immel.png|thumb|left|200px|Malcolm (left) and Immel (right) were in command of Yennir and the other soldiers.]]
In [[3640 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|4}} As "[[The Last Battle of Colonel Jace Malcom]]" takes place after the [[Battle of Corellia]] in 3640 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]], and Malcom states it has been forty years since the start of the [[Great Galactic War]] in [[3681 BBY]], the story must thus take place in 3640 BBY.</ref> during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]], Yennir of the Green served as a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] in the [[Republic Army]]. Yennir was assigned to [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Shanra Immel]]'s [[Shanra Immel's squad|squad]] and fought alongside [[Republic Special Forces Division|SpecForce]] [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Jace Malcom]] in a [[Battle of Kalandis Seven|battle]] on [[Kalandis Seven]], a desolate [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] covered in [[Water/Legends|fog]]. During the battle, Yennir and the [[Squad/Legends|squad]] were tasked with the destruction of the local Imperial-controlled [[Kalandis Seven's spaceport|spaceport]]. On the way to their target, the group of soldiers was attacked, and [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] [[Amden vor Keioidian]] was [[Death/Legends|fatally]] wounded. Immel activated Keioidian's [[med tracer]] before ordering the squad to move out and leave Keioidian behind.<ref name="TLBoCJM" />

Three [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] later, the squad finally reached their objective and started planting [[targeting beacon]]s, which would allow Republic [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] to destroy the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] regardless of the fog. Shortly after Yennir and the squad planted the last of the beacons, the fighters destroyed the spaceport with a [[Bomb/Legends|bombing]] run. Malcolm was recalled by the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] and advised the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]], a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], that the forces on Kalandis Seven would not last long without support. As the ship left the planet, Malcolm looked over a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] containing the names of the Immel's squad, including Yennir of the Green, and reflected on how he had tried to save them. He then deleted the names from the datapad, preparing to focus on the next engagement against the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].<ref name="TLBoCJM" />

==Personality and traits==
Yennir was hand-chosen by Malcolm for their proficiency, skill, and bravery to complete the mission.<ref name="TLBoCJM" />

==Skills and abilities==
Yennir of the Green had good [[Eye/Legends|eyesight]] and could see through fog as if it were [[Glass/Legends|glass]].<ref name="TLBoCJM" />

==Behind the scenes==
Yennir of the Green appeared, albeit via voice only, in [[Alexander Freed]]'s short story "[[The Last Battle of Colonel Jace Malcom]]," which was published within the [[Star Wars Insider 137|137th issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine<ref name="TLBoCJM" /> on [[October 23]], [[2012]].<ref name="release">{{TitanMagazines|url=t/star-wars-insider/us/137|text=Star Wars Insider Issue #137}}</ref>
